run_main: run the main function to play CartPole using a pre-trained DeepQ model in an infinite loop
create_gym_env: create a CartPoleBulletEnv-v1 gym environment using gym.make for PyBullet simulation
load_deepq_model: load a pre-trained DeepQ reinforcement learning model from a pickle file using deepq.load
test_env_step: test the environment step function by taking an action and receiving observation, reward, and done signals
review_main_loop: review the main function infinite loop that resets, renders, and steps through CartPole episodes
